{{Top|leg}}
The '''Zabrak grip''' was an enhanced [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] for bladed weapons designed by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] that had a reduced [[Wikipedia:Crossguard|crossguard]], allowing for both increased accuracy and damage, but less useful for parrying. This grip had been available in two versions, advanced and superior.
